svg.title: Command latency: the README speed figures
svg.desc: Twenty measured runs per cell on one M1 Pro Mac. These project-authored fixtures measure direct daemon socket commands, without MCP framing. Playwright clicks include its actionability checks. They do not establish a general website or end-to-end agent speedup. The full table retains metrics where Chromium is faster: warm local navigation took 6.5 ms with Chromium versus 12.8 ms through Umbra’s daemon socket.
